notes: All three samples are BL21 expressing Clostridium IStrons from plasmids with IPTG; no control sample. Assay set total_rnaseq: E. coli RNA was Ribo-Zero depleted 'for downstream library preparation'; the fragmentation/RppH/NEBNext Small RNA kit text is written for the C. senegalense samples, and may or may not apply to E. coli (either way, ordinary fragmentation then a kit). Temperature and aeration not given.
